terminalSequence.description: A terminal escape sequence Claude Code emits for the hook: only OSC 0, 1, 2, 9, 99, 777 and BEL. Anything else makes the field ignored. Interactive sessions only, and not from an async hook.

decision.description: Prevents the change from being applied.

title: ConfigChange hook output
description: Can stop the change from applying to the running session. Exit code 2 blocks it too. A policy_settings change cannot be blocked. A blocked change shows no message to the user or Claude. Claude Code discards continue, systemMessage, stopReason on this event.
